text: Step three, smelting, in a water jacketed blast furnace with coke and sand. Silica is the flux. It carries the iron away as a fusible slag of iron silicate. Any copper oxide is turned back into sulphide by the iron sulphide. What collects below the slag is copper matte, a melt of copper and iron sulphides, about forty five percent copper.
